say:1:1430115201:1.text: We're tracking the number of logs we have. It should be simple to subtract the number of logs leaving the warehouse from the number of logs entering the warehouse.
say:1:1430115201:1.source_cn: 我们在统计木头的剩余数量，用所有入库的木头数减去出库的...

say:2:1430115202:1.text: But we calculated three times, and the numbers just don't match!
say:2:1430115202:1.source_cn: 可是我们已经连着算了三次，数量就是对不上！为什么？
